reviews.title: Downloads vanish offline
reviews.text: Albums marked as downloaded disappear as soon as airplane mode is enabled.

reviews.title: Offline songs stop halfway
reviews.text: Downloaded songs stop after thirty seconds when there is no network connection.

reviews.title: Keeps streaming downloads
reviews.text: The app uses mobile data even when I select a downloaded playlist.

reviews.title: Cannot verify downloads
reviews.text: There is no clear indicator showing which tracks are actually available offline.

reviews.title: Offline mode forgets progress
reviews.text: Playback position resets when I reconnect after listening to downloaded music offline.

reviews.title: Lyrics are late
reviews.text: The synchronized lyrics are several lines behind the vocals on most songs.

reviews.title: Wrong lyrics version
reviews.text: Live recordings often display lyrics for the studio version and do not match the audio.

reviews.title: Lyrics disappear
reviews.text: Opening the full-screen player sometimes makes the lyrics panel completely blank.

reviews.title: No lyrics search
reviews.text: I cannot search within lyrics to find the part of a long song I want.

reviews.title: Translation covers original
reviews.text: Translated lyrics replace the original text instead of letting me view both together.

reviews.title: Playlist order changes
reviews.text: My carefully arranged playlist is reordered after I add a new track.

reviews.title: Collaborative edits lost
reviews.text: Songs added by friends vanish from our collaborative playlist after refresh.

reviews.title: Duplicate playlist tracks
reviews.text: Adding an album can create duplicate tracks without any warning.

reviews.title: Folders are missing
reviews.text: I have many playlists but cannot group them into folders on mobile.

reviews.title: Deleted playlist returned
reviews.text: A playlist I deleted came back after signing in on another device.

reviews.title: Bluetooth sounds compressed
reviews.text: Audio becomes noticeably muffled when switching from wired headphones to my car Bluetooth.

reviews.title: Volume changes between songs
reviews.text: Some tracks are much louder than others even with volume normalization enabled.

reviews.title: Lossless setting ignored
reviews.text: The player reports standard quality although lossless streaming is selected on Wi-Fi.

reviews.title: Equalizer clips bass
reviews.text: Turning on the bass equalizer causes obvious distortion at moderate volume.

reviews.title: Gapless playback has gaps
reviews.text: Live albums pause briefly between tracks even when gapless playback is enabled.

reviews.title: Recommendations repeat
reviews.text: The daily recommendations keep showing the same artists I already skipped.

reviews.title: Discovery ignores genres
reviews.text: I ask for jazz and classical music but discovery mostly recommends pop playlists.

reviews.title: Dislikes do not work
reviews.text: Songs I dislike continue to appear in radio stations and personalized mixes.

reviews.title: Too few new artists
reviews.text: The recommendation feed favors familiar stars and rarely introduces independent artists.

reviews.title: Mood mix is inaccurate
reviews.text: The focus mix frequently includes energetic tracks that interrupt concentration.
